descriptions.after: Used to enable or disable aerodynamic forces on parts and assemblies.
Maximum number of text chat bubbles shown per user.
Determines if the tail at the bottom of the text chat bubbles is visible.
Displays a chat bubble above the provided part or character.
The part or character that the bubble to be displayed above.
The text to be displayed in the chat bubble.
Called when a bubble chat is about to be displayed.
The partOrCharacter the bubble chat message is attached to.
If a TextChatMessagethose properties will be applied to the associated bubble, overridingClass.BubbleChatConfiguration` properties.
Aerodynamic forces will not be calculated on any BaseParts.
Aerodynamic forces will be calculated on BaseParts with EnableFluidForces set to true. During the beta phase, the behavior of the aerodynamic force model may change as the model improves.
